structured_proposal.proposal_text:
Design Collective: Event Proposal
Zenith Exhibition 2027
1. Proposal
Design Collective proposes 'Zenith Exhibition 2027', a Exhibition planned for 2027-02-01 at the Main
Auditorium. We expect approximately 211 attendees for this Exhibition, in line with turnout at our
previous Exhibition events. The requested budget of INR 40,000 is realistic and sufficient for this
Exhibition. Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements. This event will
significantly increase student engagement and the visibility of our club.
2. Objectives, resources and risks
Objectives: Create networking opportunities with industry and alumni; Strengthen inter-department
collaboration. Resources: Faculty mentors, printed material and refreshments. Risks: Crowd
management at peak time; Low turnout due to overlapping academic schedules.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: We expect approximately 211 attendees for this Exhibition, in line with turnout at our previous Exhibition events.
claim_verdicts.rationale: Proposed attendance (211) is within 1.15x of historical max (213), and the mean attendance is 210.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: The requested budget of INR 40,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Exhibition.
claim_verdicts.rationale: Proposed cost per attendee (INR 189.6) is within 0.7-1.3 ratio of historical mean (INR 190).

claim_verdicts.claim_text: Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
claim_verdicts.rationale: All budget variances are within ±15% and mean satisfaction is 4.62, above 4.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
claim_verdicts.rationale: Policy POL-02 is not satisfied as the submission was made 15 days before the event, less than the required 21 days.

claim_verdicts.claim_text: This event will significantly increase student engagement and the visibility of our club.
claim_verdicts.rationale: Subjective / non-verifiable forecast; no evidence can confirm it.
